description: This file defines the CatalogContext class, which configures Entity Framework's DbContext for the eShopWeb project. It specifies DbSets for baskets, catalog items, brands, types, orders, and order items, and applies entity configurations from the assembly.

classes.name: CatalogContext
classes.description: A DbContext class for managing the application's database pools, containing DbSet properties for various entities related to the catalog, baskets, and orders.

methods.name: CatalogContext
methods.description: Constructor accepting DbContextOptions to initialize the context.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides base method to configure entity mappings via assembly configurations.
